title: Alias Sale Net Payout Leaderboard
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alias:sale net_payout_usd=*
| stats sum(net_payout_usd) as total_value, avg(net_payout_usd) as avg_value by sku
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks SKU values by total and average net payout across Alias sale events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `net_payout_usd` values for each Alias sale event and review total and average net payout by SKU.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total net payout.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which SKU shows the biggest net payout numbers in your Alias sale data.
